source_event.summary: Independent audit found that a responsive UI requirement had been certified from static source inspection without runtime browser evidence.

generalized_learning.generalized_failure_pattern: A user-visible requirement that names responsiveness, viewport behavior, keyboard interaction, or browser execution can appear implemented in source while the rendered interface remains unverified.
generalized_learning.plausible_wrong_implementation: Treat responsive classes or component tests as sufficient evidence for a runtime visual/interaction contract.
generalized_learning.prevention_rule: Classify explicit rendered viewport or keyboard obligations as visual-runtime before freeze and require runtime evidence rather than static source inspection.
generalized_learning.detection_rule: Re-derive visual-runtime from covered source text and reject an attack matrix that omits that risk family or lacks head-bound executed controls.

transfer_cases.scenario: A synthetic card claims desktop/mobile support but provides only static classes; the validator must require visual-runtime and executed viewport evidence.
A synthetic settings surface requires keyboard operation; the validator must promote it to visual-runtime rather than accept source-only evidence.

skill_changes.evidence: visual-runtime is a canonical family and visual trigger terms promote relevant requirements before freeze.
validator re-derives the visual signal and generic transfer tests pass; genericity validator READY.
